assets.name: vaani
assets.prompt: Edit this existing project thumbnail. Preserve exactly the main project objects, diagram connections, layout and clean detailed anime illustration style. Change the overall color treatment to match a very pale sky-blue portfolio background #e3f0f9. Sky and outer background should be airy ice-blue, architectural whites cool and neutral. Keep Seireitei buildings recognizable in the distance, make the scenery subtle, not distracting. No additional objects, labels, title, watermark or border. Landscape 16:9.
